description: Configure Prisma database connections to include an application name identifier using the existing SERVICE_NAME environment variable. This will allow database administrators to attribute query load and monitor connections by service in database performance tools.
functional_requirements: Read the SERVICE_NAME environment variable to use as the application identifier
Set the application_name parameter on the primary (writer) Prisma database connection string
Set the application_name parameter on the replica (read) Prisma database connection string when configured
Ensure the feature works with the existing database connection configuration logic
